meta.what: RQ1 at N=3: history-run outcomes of the dense suite per memory backend and model (target task 0 of each run).
meta.unit: scenario (variant): each variant's runs averaged, then variants averaged
meta.interval: percentile bootstrap 95%, resampling variants, 2000 resamples, numpy default_rng(seed=0) per estimate
meta.paired: A minus B per shared variant, averaged over variants; a_higher/b_higher count variants; sign_test_p is a two-sided exact binomial on the variants that differ
